overview: You came back to the open leaf and read the top of it and the verse. The chronicle was still standing, and you did not take it down. You did not pick up the pen.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the leaf in the afternoon light and left the pen in the rest.

assets.name: Holinshed's Chronicles
assets.disposition: Read the morning's leaf again in the afternoon

important_dates.meaning: Read the open leaf and left the pen down
